message: Recreated September 17 nozzle using installed SAAM 0.3.13, preserving original mesh (158 mm tall, approximately 79 mm wide) and translating legacy full-fill to Slice. Switched to X1 Carbon, 0.4 mm PLA, 0.2 mm layers, 3 wall loops and solid fill; regenerated successfully with path checks passing, estimated 440.1 minutes. The X1's remembered orange colour is provisional; choose the actual spool colour in Studio before Export and confirm its mapping at the printer. Advisory retained: 32 short direct travels between Slice body wall/fill operations, none lifted. Review and Export remain with you.
